title: Finding a Favorite Museum Exhibit
title_zh: 寻找喜欢的博物馆展览
context: Ava 和 Noah 在博物馆选择参观顺序，并安排会合地点。本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: The museum has an exhibit about old trains. Want to see it?
dialogue.zh: 博物馆有个关于老式火车的展览。想看吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Definitely. I've always liked trains. Where is it?
dialogue.zh: 当然。我一直喜欢火车。展览在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: The map says it's on the second floor, near the stairs.
dialogue.zh: 地图上说在二楼，靠近楼梯。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Great. I also want to see the model town downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我还想看楼下的城镇模型。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: We could go there afterward. How much time do we have?
dialogue.zh: 之后可以去那里。我们有多少时间？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: About an hour before we need to leave for dinner.
dialogue.zh: 吃晚饭前大约还有一个小时。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: Then let's spend half an hour with the trains.
dialogue.zh: 那我们花半小时看火车吧。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: That works. Can we take pictures in this exhibit?
dialogue.zh: 可以。这个展览能拍照吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: The sign says photos are fine without flash.
dialogue.zh: 指示牌上说可以拍照，但不能用闪光灯。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: I'll turn mine off. That blue train looks interesting.
dialogue.zh: 我会把闪光灯关掉。那辆蓝色火车看起来很有意思。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: You can take a closer look. I want to read this label first.
dialogue.zh: 你可以走近看看。我想先读一下这块说明牌。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Sure. Let's meet by the stairs in ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 好。我们十分钟后在楼梯旁碰面。

expressions.zh: 想看吗？是口语中省略 Do you 的问法。
expressions.example: There's a short film. Want to see it?
Please take the picture without flash.
Take a closer look at the painting.

pronunciation: museum 的重音在第二音节；closer look 中两个词的首音节都较突出。

practice.title: Part 1 · Museums
practice.prompt: What do you like to see in a museum?
practice.answer: I enjoy seeing old objects from everyday life. They help me imagine how people lived in the past.

practice.title: Part 2 · An interesting exhibit
practice.prompt: Describe an exhibit you enjoyed. Say where it was, what you saw, and why you remember it.
practice.answer: I visited a small museum with my cousin last year. There was an exhibit about trains, and we saw a model of an old station. I liked the little buildings and the tiny people on the platform. We read a few labels and learned how passengers traveled in the past. My cousin took some photos without flash. I remember it because the model made the history easy to imagine. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Exhibits
practice.prompt: How can museums make exhibits interesting for different visitors?
practice.answer: They can use clear labels, models, and short recordings. Visitors have different interests and ways of learning, so several ways to explore a subject can help more people enjoy it.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后与朋友商量参观顺序、剩余时间和会合地点。
practice.answer: I want to see the train exhibit first. We have an hour. Let's meet by the stairs afterward.
